ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First look at the image: In this sketch map of towns, place 1 is located on the northern edge of the urban area, close to mountains, contour lines, and forest land, and belongs to a relatively open location with a relatively good environment; place A in the figure is marked with a steel plant, indicating that there is a pollution source here, and place 1 is not in the same pollution-concentrated area as place A. Then reason: A higher education park usually needs a relatively quiet and relatively good environment, and also needs to be close to the urban area for transportation and living facilities. Therefore, place 1 is most suitable to be planned as a higher education park.
